content: Out of your vulnerabilities will come your strength.
author: Sigmund Freud
sourceWork: The Psychopathology of Everyday Life / Clinical Letters
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Human beings are never a finished product; we exist in perpetual transit between our basic instincts and our highest potential. The tension we feel inside is not a flaw—it is the very engine of self-evolution.

Across his life and work, Sigmund Freud saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Growing into a fuller version of yourself requires crossing uncertain territory with no safety net. You have to be willing to outgrow the comfort of familiar limitations to step into who you are capable of becoming.
reflectionPrompt: What vulnerability or past struggle do you often try to hide from others, and how has navigating it actually strengthened your character?
